description: Save the offer. Needs `bookings:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

builder_step.description: The offer builder's step reached (only ever moves forward).

cancellation_deadline_at.description: The last moment the client may cancel (ISO 8601); null clears it.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

deposit_amount.description: A fixed deposit below the total, in minor units (cents); null returns to the rate.

deposit_rate.description: The deposit as a fraction of the total, 0.1 to 0.7.

equipment_html.description: The equipment the DJ brings, as HTML.

expected_updated_at.description: The booking's `updated_at` as you read it: a booking that changed since is refused (precondition_failed). Leave it out to have the first call read the booking and pin it.

expires_at.description: When the offer expires: at least a day out and before the event (ISO 8601); null clears it.

extras.description: Priced extras (replaces the set): an extra's slug or id and its amount in minor units.

hourly_rate_amount.description: The hourly rate, $10 to $3,000. In minor units (cents).

items.description: Other priced items (replaces the set): a name and an amount in minor units.

payment_structure.description: A deposit first, or the full amount at once.

requisites.description: Requisite slugs or ids (replaces the set).

starts_at.description: Move the booked hours: the new start (ISO 8601). starts_at, ends_at and timezone are checked together.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Chicago.

travel_amount.description: The travel fee. In minor units (cents).

name: edit_offer
title: Save the offer
